advanced-filter-description: Fëltar bu gën a xóot may na bind mbind mu am operatër yii: == != <= >= && || ( ) Diggante day séddale operatër yi. Man nga fëltar wàllu dugal yi ñu def ci soxla yépp ci bind seen tur ak seen dayo. Ci misaal: Field1 == Value1. Karmat: bu wàllu dugal yi walla dayo yi am ay diggante, war nga leen wër ak benn màndarga wax ci wet bu nekk. Ci misaal: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ngir raw arafu saytu bu kenn (' \/), man nga jëfandikoo \. Ci misaal: Field1 == I\'m. Man nga it boole ay sart yu bari. Ci misaal: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Bu ñu tànnul beneen, operatër yépp dañuy jàng jóge ci càmmooñ jëm ci ndeyjoor. Man nga soppi toftal bi ci teg ay parentës. Ci misaal: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Man nga it seet wàllu dugal yu mbind ak regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Kollee benn JSON bu génne bu Kanboard: benn objet bu am "columns" (walla tasks yu am column_name) ak benn aaray "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns dañuy nekk liis te tasks dañuy nekk kart.
import-board-instruction-deck: Kollee benn JSON bu tablo NextCloud Deck (benn tablo bu am "stacks", stack bu nekk yóbboo ay "cards"-am). Stacks dañuy nekk liis te cards dañuy nekk kart.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Kollee benn JSON bu ranngoo work-packages bu OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses dañuy nekk liis te work packages dañuy nekk kart.
import-board-instruction-issues: Kollee benn aaray JSON bu issues bu __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Issues dañuy nekk kart yu ñu boole ci liis Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Kollee benn JSON bu génne tasks bu Asana ({ "data": [...] } bu génne bu Asana walla GET /tasks). Tasks dañu leen di boole ci ay wàll (memberships); tasks yu jeex dañuy dem ci Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Kollee benn JSON bu génne list bu ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages dañuy nekk liis te items dañuy nekk kart.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Delloosi lëkkalekaay yi ci yëngu-yëngu markdown (aada gi jumtukaay markdown-kanban yi ni Obsidian Kanban di jëfandikoo): tëriindi "## Tur lëkkalekaay", ak yëf "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ci suuf. Tëriindi yi dañuy soppiku lëkkalekaay te yëf yi dañuy soppiku kart.
import-board-instruction-leo: Taqal tëralinu Leo (dencukaay .leo). Wàll yi nekk ci tolluwaay bi gën a kawe dañuy nekk ay limu, wàll yi nekk ci seen suuf ci tolluwaay bi topp dañuy nekk ay karta, te mbindum wàll bi di melokaanu karta bi. Wàll yi nekk ci tolluwaay yi gën a xóot dañuy nekk ay limu bu seetlu. Wàll yi ñu màndargaal dañu leen di dugal ni lu noppi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Taf OPML outline, ni ko Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ak yeneen outliner di génne. Mbir yi ci kaw dañuy nekk limu yi, seen doom dañuy nekk karta yi ak nòt bi ni melokaan, te mbir yi gën a xóot dañuy nekk limu yu seetlu. Mbir yi jeex dañuy dugg ni yu jeex.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Taf fiise Org mode, ni ko Emacs, Orgzly walla Beorg di bind. Bopp yi ci kaw dañuy nekk limu yi te bopp yu ñaareelu tolluwaay dañuy nekk karta yi. TODO ak DONE, njëkk yi, tag yi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ak CLOSED dañu leen di denc, te checkbox yi ak bopp yu gën a xóot dañuy nekk limu yu seetlu.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Tafal benn dencukaay todo.txt: benn liggéey ci rëdd bu nekk, ni ko jëfekaayu todo.txt ak jëfekaay yi ànd ak moom di binde. Liggéey yi jeex ("x") dañuy dem ci Jeex na, +project ak @context dañuy nekk ay màndarga, (A) di nekk màndarga bu wone li jiitu, te due: ak t: di nekk bésu àpp ak bésu tàmbali.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Tafal li génn ci task export: ab limu JSON walla benn liggéey ci bépp rëdd. Liggéey yi jeex dañuy dem ci Done, project ak priority di ay etiket, annotations di ay wax, te depends di wéeru ci liggéey yi leen di tere.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ubbi dencukaay .boardarchive bi ci zip bi te tafal li nekk ci board.jsonl bu tablo bi, ak rëddu sumb bi walla ci lu ko amul. Melo bu boole ci mbooloo ci gis-gisu tablo bi dafay doon ay limu, yeneen melo yu tànn di ay etiket, xaaju mbind ak boyetu màndarga di benn leeral ak limu bu seetlu, te wax yi dañu leen di denc. Nataal yi ak dencukaay yi ñu takkal duñu leen dugal.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ci MeisterTask, bësal ci turu projet bi, tànnal Export project te génne CSV bi, ba noppi taf ko. Section yi dañuy nekk limu yi te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak seen nòt, bis bi ñu war a jeexal, ki ñu jox ak tag yi; liggéey yi jeex dañuy denc seen bisu jeex. CSV bu ñu bind ngir import bu MeisterTask moom it dafay dox.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ci Obsidian, ubbil fiise tablo Kanban bi ni Markdown (walla ubbil fiise .md bi ci editeeru mbind), ba noppi taf ko lépp. Lane yi dañuy nekk limu yi ak seen dayob karta, karta yi dañuy denc seen tag, bis, njëkk, wàll ak limu bu seetlu, te Archive bi dafay nekk karta yu nekk ci àrsiw bi.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ci Linear, génnel issue yi ni CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, walla export bu benn view), ba noppi taf CSV bi. Status yi dañuy nekk limu yi, team yi dañuy nekk yoon yi, te issue yi dañuy nekk karta yi ak seen ki ñu jox, etiket, bis, issue bu mag, njëkk, estimate, projet ak cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ci TickTick, ubbil Settings, Account, Backup & Import te defar backup, ba noppi taf fiise CSV bi. Benn-benn limu TickTick dafay nekk yoon te ay kolonam dañuy nekk limu yi; liggéey yi dañuy denc seen tag, bis, limu bu seetlu, njëkk ak liggéey yu ndaw.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ci ClickUp, génnel liggéey yi ni CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, walla export bu List walla Table view ak kolon yépp), ba noppi taf CSV bi. Status yi dañuy nekk limu yi, limu ClickUp yi dañuy nekk yoon yi, te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi ak seen liggéey yu ndaw, ñi ñu jox, tag, bis, njëkk ak waxtu.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ci Nullboard, ubbil tablo bi, tànnal Export this board... ci menu bi, ubbil fiise .nbx bi ci editeeru mbind te taf li ci biir. Limu yi dañuy nekk limu yi te nòt yi dañuy nekk karta yi: rëddu njëkk bu nòt bi mooy turu karta bi te li ci des mooy melokaanam. Nòt bu raw dafay am etiket raw. Fiise bu am ay tablo dafay dugal tablo bu njëkk bi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ci Kanri, ubbil Import & Export te tànnal Export individual board (walla Export all data), ba noppi taf fiise .json bi. Kolon yi dañuy nekk limu yi te karta yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak seen melokaan, bis bi ñu war a jeexal, tag ak melo; liggéey yu karta dañuy nekk limu bu seetlu. Ci export bu all-data, tablo bu njëkk bi lañuy dugal.
import-board-instruction-planka: Bindal adrees bu sa Planka (misaal https://planka.example.com), sa turu jëfandikukat bi ak sa baatu jall bu Planka, ba noppi bësal "Wone limu". Dañu leen di jëfandikoo rekk ngir jël tablo bi te duñu leen denc. Tànnal benn tablo te bësal "Jël": WeKan dina ko jàng ci API bu Planka, ak ay limam, karta yi, melokaan yi, bisi jeex yi, etiket yi, way-bokk yi, limu liggéey yi ak xalaat yi, ba noppi nga wéy ci dugal bi ni mu baaxoo. Karta yi nekk ci àrsiw bu Planka dañuy dugg ñu ngi ci àrsiw; dencukaay yu ñu takk ak karta yi nekk ci mbalit mi duñu dugg.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Ci Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), duggal, nangul sañ-sañ Tasks.Read te duppil token bi ci onglet Access token. Taafal ko fii te bësal "Wone limu"; token bi dañu koy jëfandikoo rekk ngir jël bii te duñu ko denc. Tànnal limu yépp walla benn limu te bësal "Jël". Bépp limu To Do day nekk limu, bépp liggéey day nekk karta, ak ay notam, bisi jeex ak bisi tàmbali, tappaay yi ni limu bu seetlu, xeet yi ni etiket, solo bu kawe ak nekkin wi ni etiket; liggéey yi jeex dañuy yóbbu ci àrsiw bi. Fàttaliku yi ak delloo yi duñu dugg.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Ci KanbanFlow, ubbil menu bu tablo bi, tànnal Settings → API & Webhooks te duppil token API bu tablo bi. Taafal token bi fii, bësal "Wone limu", tànnal tablo bi te bësal "Jël"; token bi dañu koy jëfandikoo rekk ngir jël boobu te duñu ko denc. Kolon yi dañuy nekk limu, yoon yi des yoon; liggéey yi dañuy denc seen melokaan, seen kulóor, etiket yi, bisi jeex bi, liggéey yu ndaw yi ni limu bu seetlu, waxtu wi ñu jëfandikoo, xayma bi, nit ñi ak xalaat yi.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Bindal ID bu sa kontu Basecamp (nimero bi topp basecamp.com/ ci adrees bi) ak benn token bu dugg (bu jóge ci benn app OAuth 2 bu ñu bind ci launchpad.37signals.com, walla bu benn integraasioŋ bu am ba pare am), bësal "Wone limu", tànnal benn porose te bësal "Jël". Token bi dañu koy jëfandikoo rekk ngir jël boobu te duñu ko denc. Bépp taabal karta day nekk yoon ak ay kolonam ni limu, te limu yi ñu wara def dañuy nekk yoon "To-dos"; karta yi ak li ñu wara def dañuy denc seen mbind, bis yi, ñi ñu ko jox ak xalaat yi, tappaay yu karta day nekk limu bu seetlu, te yi jeex dañuy yóbbu ci àrsiw bi.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Jëlal benn token bu dugg ci OAuth 2.0 Playground: ci suufu Tasks API v1 tànnal tasks.readonly, bësal Authorize APIs, ba noppi Exchange authorization code for tokens, te duppil access token bi. Taafal ko fii te bësal "Wone limu", tànnal limu liggéey yépp walla benn, ba noppi "Jël". Token bi dañu koy jëfandikoo rekk ngir jël bii te duñu ko denc. Limu liggéey yi dañuy nekk limu, liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta, ak seen not yi, lëkkalekaay yi ak bisi jeex bi; liggéey yu ndaw yi dañuy nekk limu bu seetlu te liggéey yi jeex dañuy dugg ñu ngi ci àrsiw.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API bu Google Keep mu ngi jagleel kontu Google Workspace rekk. Jëlal benn token bu dugg OAuth 2.0 bu am scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (ci OAuth 2.0 Playground su sa admin Workspace nangoo, walla ci benn kontu sarwiis bu am delegaasioŋ ci domeen bi yépp), taafal ko, bësal "Wone limu" ba noppi "Jël". Token bi dañu koy jëfandikoo rekk ngir jël bii te duñu ko denc. Not yu mbind dañuy nekk karta ci limu "Notes", te not yu limu bu seetlu dañuy nekk karta ci limu "Lists" ak seeni elemaa ni limu bu seetlu. Not yi nekk ci mbalit mi, dencukaay yu ñu takk ak séddoo duñu dugg.
api-import-desc: Jëlal ko ci sarwiis bi ak sa bopp kontu. Li ngay bind fii dañu koy jëfandikoo rekk ngir jël bii te duñu ko denc.
api-import-fetched: Jël nañu ko. Seetal way-bokk yi ci suuf te dugal.
api-import-nothing: Amul dara lu ñu mën a dugal ak kontu bii.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ci Pivotal Tracker, ubbil onglet MORE bu projet bi te tànnal Export CSV (walla tànnal story yi te tànnal Bulk Actions, CSV), ba noppi taf CSV bi. Benn-benn nekkinu story dafay nekk limu te story yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak seen xeet ak etiket, boroom yi, ki laaj, bis, xalaat, liggéey ak blocker; Estimate dafay nekk Story points te iteration yi dañuy nekk sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ci Tasks.org, ubbil Settings, Backups te tànnal Export tasks, ba noppi taf li nekk ci fiise .json boobu. Limu yi dañuy nekk limu yi te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak seen nòt, tag, bis, xalaat ak liggéey yu ndaw; liggéey yi jeex dañuy denc seen bisu jeex, te njëkk dafay nekk wàll bu ñu def ci soxla.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ci monday.com, ubbil menuw tablo bi, tànnal More actions ak Export board to Excel (ak updates ak subitems su la neexee), ba noppi tànnal fiise .xlsx boobu. Kolon Status dafay nekk limu yi te group yi dañuy nekk yoon yi; nit ñi, bis yi, timeline ak tag yi dañuy denc seen palaas, yeneen kolon dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla te updates yi dañuy nekk xalaat.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ci Super Productivity, ubbil Settings, ba noppi Sync & Backup, tànnal Export Data te taf li nekk ci fiise sp-backup .json bi. Benn-benn projet dafay nekk yoon te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi ci To Do, In Progress, Backlog walla Done, ak seen nòt, tag, bis bi ñu war a jeexal, waxtu bi ñu jël ak liggéey yu ndaw; liggéey yi nekk ci àrsiw dañuy nekk karta yu nekk ci àrsiw bi.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ci Taiga, ubbil Admin > Project > Export te yeb dump bu projet bi (ubbil fiise .json.gz bi njëkk), ba noppi taf JSON bi. Status yu user story dañuy nekk limu yi, user story yi dañuy nekk karta yi ak seen liggéey ni liggéey yu ndaw, epic ak issue yi dañuy am seen yoon, te sprint, tag, xalaat ak attribute yu ñu def ci soxla dañuy ànd ak ñoom. Takkaay yi duñu leen dugal.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ci Vikunja, ubbil Settings, tànnal Data Export te yeb fiise .zip bi mu la yónne, ba noppi tànnal fiise boobu, walla taf data.json bi nekk ci biir. Bucket yu Kanban dañuy nekk limu yi te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak seen etiket, ñi ñu jox, bis, melokaan, limu liggéey ni limu yu seetlu ak xalaat; njëkk, xaaju done ak done dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla. Takkaay yi duñu leen dugal.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ci Quire, ubbil menuw projet bi te tànnal Export CSV, ba noppi taf CSV bi. Status yi dañuy nekk limu yi te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak seen liggéey yu ndaw ni karta yu doom, ñi ñu jox, tag ni etiket, bisu tàmbali, bis bi ñu war a jeexal ak bisu jeex, melokaan ak njëkk ni wàll bu ñu def ci soxla. Xalaat ak takkaay nekkuñu ci CSV bu Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ci Wrike, génnel projet walla kaas ci Excel, walla fees template import Excel bu Wrike, ba noppi tànnal fiise .xlsx boobu. Rëddu kaas ak projet dañuy nekk yoon yi, Status dafay nekk limu yi te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak seen Key, liggéey bu mag, ñi ñu jox, bisu tàmbali ak bisu jeex, dependency ak melokaan; Priority, Duration ak yeneen kolon dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ci Teamwork.com, feesal template import liggéey Excel bi (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) te denc ko ni .xlsx, ba noppi tànnal fiise boobu. Limu liggéey yi dañuy nekk limu yi te liggéey yi dañuy nekk karta yi; liggéey bu tàmbalee ak -, # walla > dafay nekk liggéey wu ndaw bu liggéey bi ci kawam (--, ## walla >> benn tolluwaay bu gën a xóot). Ñi ñu jox, bis ak tag yi dañuy denc seen palaas; Priority, Estimated time ak Complete dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ci Businessmap (bu njëkk Kanbanize), ubbil Advanced Search, tànnal Configure results ngir tànn kolon yi, yeb fiise Excel bi, ba noppi tànnal fiise .xlsx boobu. Kolon yi dañu leen di jàng ci seen tur ci Angale (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): su sa kont di jëfandikoo beneen làkk, soppil rëddu bopp bi ci Angale njëkk. Column dafay nekk limu yi te Lane yoon yi; boroom yi, tag, melo, bis, xalaat ak lëkkalekaayu mag yi dañuy denc seen palaas, te Priority, Size, Type ak yeneen kolon dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ci Redmine, ubbil Issues bu projet bi, tànnal Also available in: CSV ci suufu limu bi, tànnal kolon yi (All columns, ak Description) te génne, ba noppi taf CSV bi. Redmine dafay tudd kolon yi ci sa làkk, kon defal sa làkk Angale ci My account balaa ngay génne. Benn-benn status dafay nekk limu te issue yi dañuy nekk karta yi, ak tracker bi ni etiket, ki ñu jox, ki bind, bis, liggéey bu mag ak issue yu ñu lëkkale; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done ak custom fields dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ci Notion, ubbil database bi ni xët bu mat, tànnal ••• ak Export, tànnal Markdown & CSV, te tànnal fiise .zip bi mu yeb, walla benn CSV bu database ci biir, walla taf CSV boobu. Kolon bu tudd Status dafay nekk limu yi (su amul, kolon bu njëkk bi mel ni select mooy nekk, te rapóoru import bi dafay wax bi); rëdd yi dañuy nekk karta yi ak seen tur, tag ni etiket, nit ni bokkkat, bis, ak mbindu xët bi ni melokaan; yeneen kolon dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla. Relations, nataal ak takkaay duñu leen dugal.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ci Plane, ubbil Workspace Settings, tànnal Exports, génnel projet yi ni JSON, CSV walla Excel te yeb fiise .zip bi, ba noppi tànnal fiise boobu, walla benn fiise ci biiram, walla taf JSON walla CSV bi. States yi dañuy nekk limu yi, projet yi dañuy nekk yoon yi, te issue yi dañuy nekk karta yi ak seen identifier, mag, ñi ñu jox, etiket, bis, lëkkalekaay ak xalaat; priority, estimate, cycle ak module dañuy nekk wàll yu ñu def ci soxla. Export bu Plane amul melokaan walla takkaay, kon duñu leen dugal.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ci sa tablo Trello, demal ci «Menu», ba noppi «More», «Print and Export», «Export JSON», te sotti mbind mi mu génne.
import-board-instruction-csv: Tafal sa done yi ci CSV (dayo yi ñu séddale ak virgül) / TSV (dayo yi ñu séddale ak tab).
import-board-instruction-jira: Kollee JSON bi jóge ci Jira Cloud REST API issue search (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), walla benn objet bu mel ni { "issues": [...] }. Statuses yu Jira dañuy nekk liis te issues dañuy nekk kart. Su la neexee boole benn aaray "automationRules" ngir dugal sart yi.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Seet man na am ay operatër ngir gën a tànn li ñuy seet. Ñuy wax operatër bi ci bind turam ak dayo bi, séddale leen ak ñaari tomb (:). Ci misaal, `list:Blocked` dina yam seet bi ci karta yi nekk ci limu bu tudd *Blocked*. Bu dayo bi am ay diggante walla ay araf yu wuute, war nga ko wër ak ñaari màndarga wax (ci misaal `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - karta yi ñu war a jeexal ci diir bu tollu ci *<n>* fan jóge ci léegi. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__` day lim karta yépp yi seen bisu jeexal weesu na.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - karta yi ñu sos ci *<n>* fan yi weesu walla lu ëppul loolu
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - karta yi ñu soppi ci *<n>* fan yi weesu walla lu ëppul loolu
globalSearch-instructions-status-archive: `__predicate_archived__` - karta yi ñu denc ci àrsiw
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - karta yépp, yi ñu denc ci àrsiw ak yi ñu dencul
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - karta yi nekk ci tablo yi ñépp man a gis rekk
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - karta yi nekk ci tablo yu sutura rekk
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<tool>` - *<tool>* mooy benn ci `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` walla `__predicate_member__`. Bu ñu tegee `-` ci kanamu *<tool>*, dafay seet ñakkug njariñ ci tool boobu (misaal, `has:-due` dafay seet karta yi amul bés bu mu war a jeex).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - *<sort-name>* dafay doon `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` walla `__predicate_modified__`. Ngir toftale bu wàññiku, teg `-` ci kanamu turu toftale bi.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - *<n>* mooy lim bu mat te ëpp 0, di limu karta yi ñuy wone ci xët wu nekk.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Man nga wax ay operatër yu bari.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Operatër yi niroo dañuy boole ak *OR* (walla). Dinañu wone karta yi dëppoo ak benn ci sart yi.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` dina wone karta yi nekk ci limu bu tudd *Blocked* walla *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Operatër yi wuute dañuy boole ak *AND* (ak). Karta yi dëppoo ak operatër yu wuute yépp rekk lañuy wone. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` dina wone karta yi nekk ci limu *Available* te am etiket *red* rekk.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Man nga wax fan yi ak lim bu mat bu am màndarga + walla -, walla jëfandikoo `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` walla `__predicate_year__` ngir diir bi ñu nekk.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Seet mbind du wuute diggante araf yu mag ak araf yu ndaw.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Bu ñu tànnul beneen, duñu seet karta yi ñu denc ci àrsiw.

database-migration-description: Toxal données yu mbind (lépp lu dul takkaay ak avatar, yi di des ci filesystem) diggante MongoDB ak FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Beneen database bi war naa dox te man a jotu (port yu défo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; soppi ko ak WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ginnaaw bi mu jeex, jublal MONGO_URL ci beneen database bi te tàmbalaat WeKan (ci Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb walla =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Toxal données yu mbind ci FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migrate-to-mongodb: Toxal données yu mbind ci MongoDB
database-migration-confirm: Kopye collections yépp yu mbind ci __db__? Takkaay ak avatar yi nekk ci filesystem duñu leen jàppale. Database bi ñu jëm war naa dox.
database-migration-done: Migration bu données yu mbind jeex na.
sandstorm-migration-description: Su WeKan di dox ci biir benn grain bu Sandstorm, database bu MongoDB 3 bu màggat bi ñu koy toxal ci FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ci ubbi bu njëkk, te takkaay ak avatar yi ñu leen di jële ci database bi jëme ci dosye yu grain bi files/attachments ak files/avatars. Lii day wone ndax migration bi antu na te ñaata espaas ci disk la fiise yu database bu MongoDB bu raw bu màggat bi jëfandikoo ba léegi ci biir grain bi, te day may la far fiise yu raw yooyu ngir goreel espaas.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: Fiise yu database MongoDB 3 yu raw
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Far fiise yu database MongoDB yu raw
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ginnaaw benn migration bu antu, données yi dañuy nekk ci FerretDB ak ci filesystem, kon fiise yu database MongoDB 3 yu raw yu màggat yi ñu mën leen far ngir goreel espaas ci disk bu grain bi. Loolu mënuñu ko delloo ginnaaw.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Far fiise yu database MongoDB 3 yu raw ngir goreel espaas ci disk? Données yi toxalu nañu ba noppi ci FerretDB ak filesystem. Loolu mënuñu ko delloo ginnaaw.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Fiise yu database MongoDB yu raw far nañu, goreel
features-desc: Feem yu WeKan may te nga man leen a tànn. Feem bu ñu tànnul dina nëbbu ci bépp jëfandikukat. Ay rootaanam dañuy des ci denc bi te ndigal yi duñu soppeeku.
feature-views-table-desc: Tablo bi mel ni taabal bu karta yu ñu man a toftal.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Arminaat ak arminaat bu tablo yu bari.
feature-views-overview-desc: Lim yi, boole ci ki ñu jox liggéey bi, pexe liggéey bi, tablo bu natt yi ak tablo bu mag bi.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Ñetti anam yu wone nataali Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Liggéeyi mbind mi yi des, diir yu gàtt yu liggéey, raapooru diir boobu ak gaawaayu liggéey.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Liggéey yi des, liggéey yi jeex, doxin wi ñu boole, diiru liggéey ak diiru xaar, limu liggéey yi jeex, diir bi liggéey yi xaar, li leen tere, Monte Carlo ak yeneen natt yu doxinu liggéey.
feature-views-map-desc: Karta yi mel ni màndarga ci nataal bu ñu yónnee.
feature-approval-required: Bàyyil feem yi yeesalug WeKan yokk ñu suux ba ab saytukat doxal leen
feature-preview-admins: Saytukat yi dañuy gis feem yu suux yi ngir jëkk a seet naka lañuy doxe
feature-pilot-users: Jëfandikukat yu nattu yi te itam dañuy gis feem yu suux yi
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Turi jëfandikukat yi, te xaajale leen ak wirgil
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Denc nañu ko. Gisunu turi jëfandikukat yii:
card-field-visibility-desc: Wàll yu Jekkalu Tablo / Karta yi tablo yi man a won. Wàll bu ñu màndargaalul dañu koy nëbb ci karta yépp, minicard yépp ak Jekkalu Tablo / Karta bu tablo yépp. Benn done bu karta walla jekkalu tablo du soppiku, te bu ñu ko màndargaalaatee dafay won benn-benn tablo ni mu nekkoon. Toftalinu wàll yi, benn-benn tablo am na sa moom.
cards-loading-auto: Ci boppam (yeb ndànk ngir tabax yu réy rekk)
cards-loading-description: Ni tablo bu nekk di yebe kart-am yi. Kart yépp: kart bu nekk ñu koy yeb ci navigateur (gën a yomb, feature yépp dañuy dox, waaye tablo bu am junni-junni kart day yónnee données yu bare ci ku ko xool bu nekk). Lazy: liis bu nekk day yeb kart yi feeñ rekk (défilement bu àpp du am) ak benn lim bu dund, kon tablo yu réy lool dañuy jëfandikoo mémoire ak bande passante yu néew. Ñu koy tegal it ak variable CARDS_LOADING.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Yeb kart bu lazy benn eksperimaas la: kontër yu kart ak dig yu WIP dañu jub, waaye xool yu Calendrier/Table/Gantt ak tànn yu bare dañuy wone rekk kart yi ñu yeb ba léegi. Yebbaatal tablo yu ubbeeku ginnaaw bi nga koy soppi.
render-links-as-plain-text: Wone lëkkalekaay yi ni mbind mu set
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Bu doxee, lëkkalekaay yépp (yu markdown ni [label](url) ak yu HTML yu raw <a href>) ñu leen di wone bu baax ni mbind mu set mu ñu mënul bës, ci bépp barab bu mbind bu am solo (tur yu tablo ak kart, melokaan, komanter, checklist, aki yeneen). Loolu day tere lëkkalekaay yu mën a nax. Défo mooy taxaw, kon lëkkalekaay yi dañuy des yu ñu mën a bës.
always-show-code-as-text: Wone code yépp saa su ne ni mbind mu set
always-show-code-as-text-description: Bu doxee, mbind mu am solo duñu ko wone mukk ni markdown walla HTML: source bi yépp ñu koy wone saa su ne ni mbind mu set ci bépp barab bu mbind bu am solo (tur yu tablo ak kart, melokaan, komanter, checklist, aki yeneen). Loolu day feeñal li nëbbu — komanter yu HTML (<!-- -->), fu markdown link yi jëm, JavaScript ak bépp code bu ci des — kon code yépp saa su ne dañu koy gis, du ñu mën koo bës, te du dox. Défo mooy taxaw, kon markdown ñu koy wone ni mu waree.
disable-all-import-description: Bu doxee, feature yu dugal yépp ñu leen di taxawal: dugal benn tablo jóge ci WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ak Forgejo, ak it duppal benn tablo. Menu yu dugal yi ñu leen di nëbb te serwër bi day dëddu bépp laaj bu dugal. Défo mooy taxaw.
disable-all-export-description: Bu doxee, feature yu génne yépp ñu leen di taxawal: génne benn tablo ni WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, walla ci NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ak génne takkaay bu benn. Menu yu génne yi ñu leen di nëbb te serwër bi day dëddu bépp laaj bu génne. Défo mooy taxaw.
disable-import-avatars-description: Bu doxee, avatar yi (nataal yu profil bu jëfandikukat) duñu leen dugal mukk. Lii ñeel na dugal WeKan JSON, dugal Trello, ak sync bu avatar jóge ci provider yu identité yu biti ci dugg (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Tur ak yeneen données ñu leen di dugal ba tey; avatar yi rekk lañuy jump. Défo mooy taxaw.
disable-export-avatars-description: Bu doxee, avatar yi (nataal yu profil bu jëfandikukat) duñu leen boole mukk ci génne benn tablo (WeKan JSON ak génne CSV). Turu jëfandikukat ak yeneen données ñu leen di génne ba tey; avatar yi rekk lañuy bàyyi. Défo mooy taxaw.
anonymize-import-users-description: Bu doxee, dugal benn tablo WeKan JSON day wuutu turu jëfandikukat bu nekk, tur bu mat ak initiale ci ay placeholder yu kont (user1, user2, ...), day dindi seen avatar, te day bindaat mention yu @username (ak champ yu requested-by / assigned-by) ci biir kart ak komanter yu ñu dugal. Amul identité bu dëgg bu jëfandikukat bu jóge ci tablo bi ñu jële bu ñu denc. Baatu "user" day topp làkku ku dugal. Défo mooy taxaw.
anonymize-export-users-description: Bu doxee, génne benn tablo day wuutu turu jëfandikukat bu nekk, tur bu mat ak initiale ci ay placeholder yu kont (user1, user2, ...), day dindi seen avatar, te day bindaat mention yu @username (ak champ yu requested-by / assigned-by) ci biir kart ak komanter. Fiise bi ñu génne du yóbbaale benn identité bu dëgg bu jëfandikukat. Baatu "user" day topp làkku ku génne. Défo mooy taxaw.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Bu doxee, génne benn tablo day wuutu turu jëfandikukat bu nekk, tur bu mat ak initiale ci ay placeholder yu kont (user1, user2, ...), day dindi seen avatar, te day bindaat mention yu @username (ak champ yu requested-by / assigned-by) ci biir kart ak komanter. Fiise bi ñu génne du yóbbaale benn identité bu dëgg bu jëfandikukat. Baatu "user" day topp làkku ku génne. Défo mooy taxaw.
disable-activities-description: Bu doxee, entree yu fil bu aktiwite duñu leen bind mukk te duñu leen wone fenn (wetu-mbind bu tablo ak onglet bu aktiwite bu kart). Amul taariix bu ku def lan bu ñu denc. Défo mooy taxaw.
disable-notifications-description: Bu doxee, WeKan du yónnee mukk yégle yu wottu (ci app, email walla yeneen serwis) ngir bépp aktiwite. Aktiwite yi mën nañu leen bind ba tey (su ñu leen taxawalul ci kaw); yégle yi rekk lañuy tere. Défo mooy taxaw.
disable-watch-description: Bu doxee, feature bu wottu ñu ko taxawal — jëfandikukat yi mënuñu jàpp ci tablo, liis walla kart ngir jot yégle, te bépp jéem ci soppi daraja bu wottu ñu koy dëddu. Défo mooy taxaw.
backup-description: Denc backup bu Takkaay, Avatar ak/walla Données (collections yépp yu mbind yu dul takkaay walla avatar). .zip bi ñu koy sotti jonn ci storage bi ñu tànn — amul fiise bu taxaw — ni backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, bu ëmb YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ak /data. Storage yu cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) dañuy jëfandikoo identifiant yu ñu tegal ci seen onglet yu storage.
backup-scope-description: Serwëer bépp, walla benn organisation. Dencu organisation dafa ëmb ay tablo yi ak lépp lu ci nekk, ak ay dàttu tablo yooyu — waaye du ëmb benn kont ci jëfandikoukat yi walla mbir yu serwëer bi, ndax organisation yépp a koy bokk. Delloosi dencu organisation dafay bind rekk ci tablo yi mu moom.
theme-override-all-tenants: Tànneef bu jëm ci luqatkat yépp
continuous-backup: Denc kopi bu wóor te du taxaw
continuous-backup-description: Dafay yónnee bépp coppite ci dàttub xibaar yi, takkaay yi, nataali jëfandikukat yi ak bindu liggéey yi ci ab wayndare ci ay simili yu néew, ngir ñu man a delloo tolluwaay bi ci bépp waxtu. Dafay ànd ak denc gi ñu jàppal waxtu, di def ay kopi yu mat.
continuous-backup-enabled: Doxal denc kopi bu wóor te du taxaw ci serwëër bii
continuous-backup-target: Wayndare bi ñuy denc ci (yoon wu mat, ci beneen disk, barab bu ñu bokk ci lëkkale gi walla barab bu rclone lëkkal)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Xëti SQLite (xët yi soppeeku ci diggante waxtu bu nekk)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (porogaraam boo bëggee nga samp ko)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Amul moteeru dàttub xibaar bu man a dox ci serwëër bii
continuous-backup-base-every: Def kopi bu bees bu cosaan bi ci diggante (waxtu)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Làq kopi bu wóor bi ak kóod bu nëbbu (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Fiise bu caabig kóod bu nëbbu (yoon wu mat ci biti wayndare bi ñuy denc ci; 64 màndarga ci sistemu lim bu sukkandiku ci 16 walla wax ju nëbbu ju am lu néew néew 16 màndarga). Dencal benn kopi: bu fiise bii amul, maneesul a delloo kopi bu wóor bi.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Bul yónnee fenn (wayndare bi ñuy denc ci rekk)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Wayndare ci biir ndab li ñuy denc ci
continuous-backup-fetched: Jëlees na fiise yi ci niir wi
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Fiise bu ñuy doxal bu Litestream (yoon wu mat)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Fiise bu dàttub xibaar bu SQLite (ñu sos ko ci wetug kopi bi, du bind mukk ci kaw fiise bi ñuy jëfandikoo)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Jëfandikoo dàttub xibaar bu SQLite bi ñu tabaxaat ci tàmbaliwaat gi di ñëw (dàttub xibaar bu yàgg bi ñu wuutal dañu koy denc)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Delloo maas bi ñu tànn ci waxtu wi ñu tànn? Denc gi wéy dina taxaw tuuti bi delloo gi di dox.
continuous-backup-saved: Tànneefi denc kopi bu wóor te du taxaw denc nañu leen
backup-restore-select-first: Tànn benn backup ci liis bi ci njëkk.
backup-restore-confirm: Delloo backup bi ñu tànn? Takkaay/avatar yi ñu leen di bind ci filesystem te données yi ci database ci anam bi ñu tànn.
gcs-key-filename: Yoonu fiise bu kley bu service account
gcs-key-filename-description: Bu ñu mënul soxla: yoon bu fiise bu kley JSON bu service account ci serwër bi.
gcs-credentials-description: Bu ñu mënul soxla: kollee kley JSON bu service account. Bàyyil ko neen ngir jëfandikoo fiise bu kley walla identifiant yu défo.
gcs-permissions-note: Jox service account bu WeKan sañ-sañu jàng/bind ci bucket bi: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → sa bucket → Permissions → Grant access. Ci "New principals", kollee email bu service account — valëeru "client_email" bu jóge ci sa kley JSON — ba noppi tànn role bi "Storage Object Admin" te Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Bàyyil ko neen ngir denc valëeru léegi bi.
azure-account-name-description: Turu sa kont bu Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Container bu blob bi ñuy denc fiise.
gcs-project-id-description: ID bu sa project bu Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Turu bucket bu Cloud Storage bi ñuy denc fiise.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: bàyyil ko neen (day jëfandikoo endpoint bu région). S3-compatible: URL bu Endpoint bu jóge ci sa console MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → sa bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → turu sa bucket (walla Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → sa jëfandikukat → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → tànn use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Ñu koy wone ni 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Ekraan bu mel ni Access key ID bi; 'Secret access key' ñu koy wone benn yoon rekk bu ñu sos kley bi — kopye ko ca (walla Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sa kont → tur bi ñu wone ci kaw (it ci Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sa kont → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sa kont → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → sa kont → Data storage → Containers → sa container (walla + Container ngir sos benn).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → sélecteur bu project ci kaw → ID bu sa project (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).

email-recovery-description: Benn rëdd ci ku jot bataaxal ku nekk. Seetal ak ID bu jëfandikukat bi. Dañuy nëbb ëmbiitu bataaxal yi ak barabi email yu kiy jot. Taxawal gi dafay téye bataaxal yi fi nekk ak yi di ñëw; dellusi ci yónnee dafay jéemaat yónnee bataaxal yi ci rëdd mi léegi. Bàyyi dafay far bataaxal yi ñu dugal ci rëdd mi ba ci waxtu laaj bi. Su yónnee di dox, jéemaat ci kanam tuuti. Bataaxal bi ñu tàmbali yónnee mëneesul a delloo, te yónnee guñu wóorul mën na am ñaari yoon. Njumte yiy sax ak bataaxal yi agsi ci àppu jéem yi dañuy des ngir ñu seetaat leen. Jéemaat bataaxal yi antuwul dafay tàmbaliwaat jéem yi te sàmm taxawal gi fi nekk.

email-failure-retry-limit: Dig bu jéem yu otomatik yi jot na
sync-time-estimate-hint: Estimasioŋu waxtu yi dañuy jëfandikoo wàll yu nimero yu waxtu bu njëkk/bi des yi import Jira sos. War na am benn wàll rekk bu dëppoo ci tablo bii. Soppi yi fi nekk dañu leen di saytu ni xuloo; njëg yu fi mu jóge yu amul dañu leen di bàyyi te null bu leer dafay setal njëg bi.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint ak génne yi dañu leen di yemale rekk bi Scrum doxee ci tablo bii. Sprint walla génne bu amul dañu koy sos ci tablo bii, ak bis yi fi mu jóge jox; bu am ba noppi dañu koy méngale ci ID bu fi mu jóge njëkk, ba noppi ci tur. Coppiteb naal bu fi nekk dafay des ba fi mu jóge soppi naalu issue boobu, te Yemale bu njëkk du dindi naal mukk.
activity-recovery-description: Yégle yi jeexul dañu leen di jéemaat ci otomatik. Saytul jëf yi amul walla yi soppiku balaa ngay jéemaat. Jéemaat du sosaat benn jëf mukk.
activity-recovery-empty: Amul yéglew jëf yu ngi xaar.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Mënuñu yeb yéglew jëf yi ngi xaar.
activity-recovery-retrying: Mi ngi yeesal yónneeb yégle bi…
activity-recovery-status-preparing: Mi ngi xaar naalu ñi ñuy yónne
activity-recovery-status-changed: Jëf bu njëkk bi soppiku na
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Naal bi ak jëf bi ngi xaar dëppoowuñu
activity-recovery-busy: Beneen liggéeykat mi ngi toppatoo yégle bii. Yeesalal te jéemaat.
activity-recovery-denied: Jotu ki ñuy yónne walla tànnam ci yégle yi mayatul yónnee bi.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Jëf bu njëkk bi amatul walla soppiku na. Sosaatuñu dara.
activity-recovery-disabled: Yéglew jëf yi dañu leen taxawal.
activity-recovery-failed: Mënuñu jeexal yónneeb yégle bi. Liggéey bi ngi xaar denc nañu ko.
activity-recovery-paused: Yónneeb yéglew jëf yi dañu ko taxawal ab diir.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Yégle bii soppiku na ginaaw bi ñu ko yebee. Saytul anam bi ñu yeesal balaa ngay jéemaat.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Mënuñu dëggal jekkalu yónnee bi. Yeesalal te saytu anam bi mu nekk léegi.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: Yónneeb yéglew jëf yi dañu ko neenal.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Neenal ba fàww yónnee bi des ci jëf bii? Mënuñu koo wéyalaat. E-mail yi nekk ci toftal ba noppi ak yégle yi ñu yónne ba noppi duñu leen delloo.
rule-email-recovery-heading: Yónnee bataaxali elektaroniig yu sàrt yi
rule-email-recovery-description: Seetal jéem yi ñu bind ngir yónnee bataaxali elektaroniig yu sàrt yi. Jéem yi wóoragul mën nañu nekk ci yónnee ba tey walla dog nañu. Rapoor bii du yónneewaat te du dakkal yónnee gi.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Serwëru bataaxal bi nangu na ko
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Xibaar yi leeral jéem bi baaxul
rule-email-recovery-empty: Amul jéem yónnee bataaxalu elektaroniig bu sàrt yi bu méngoo ak seet bii.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Mënuñu yeb jéemu e-mail yu dagaatu yi. Yeesalal ngir jéemaat.
rule-email-recovery-dropped: Saytukat bi dakkal na yónnee gi
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan du yónneewaat mukk ci boppam bataaxalu elektaroniig bu jot gi wóoragul. Yónneewaat gi ñi jot gi wóoragul rekk la jëm. Màndargaal ko ne yónnee nañu ko boo xamee ne agsi na, walla dakkal yónnee gi.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Yónnee gu njëkk gi mën na nekk ci yoon ba tey. Mën nga dogal gannaaw __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Yónneewaat bataaxal bii ñi jot gi wóoragul? Ku sa serwëru bataaxal nangu ko te yëgalul WeKan, dinga ko jot ñaari yoon.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Màndargaal bataaxal bii ne yónnee nañu ko ñépp? Defal loolu rekk boo xamee ne agsi na.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Dakkal yónnee bataaxal bii? Deesu ko yónnee ñi jot gi wóoragul.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Yónnee gu njëkk gi mën na nekk ci yoon ba tey. Jéemaatal ci kanam.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Bataaxal bii jël nañu ci dogal ba noppi.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Benn yónneewaat bu jiitu mën na nekk ci yoon ba tey. Jéemaatal ci kanam.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Ñi koy jot ñépp wóoral nañu leen ba noppi. Màndargaal ko ne yónnee nañu ko ci wàllu yónneewaat.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Serwëru bataaxal bi tontuwul. Bataaxal bi ñu yónneewaat mën na agsi walla bañ a agsi; dañu koy wone ne mu ngi ci yoon.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Beneen saytukat moo ngi jël dogal ci bataaxal bii. Jéemaatal ci kanam tuuti.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Bataaxal bi ñu denc àndatul ak jéem gii, moo tax mënuñu cee jël dogal fii.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Li ñu denc ci jéem gii baaxul, moo tax mënuñu cee jël dogal fii.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Mënuñu jël dogal ci bataaxal bii. Yeesalal xët wi te jéemaat.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Bataaxali règl yi xaar ñu seetlu leen
rule-email-legacy-description: Bataaxali règl yii sumbu WeKan bu yàgg moo leen waajal te bindul fu seen ëmbiit jóge, moo tax WeKan du leen yónnee ci boppam. Seetlal njëkk ndax ki sos règl bi am na ba tey sañ-sañu dugg, te lëkkalewaatal bataaxal bi ngir waajalaat ko ci karta bi ni mu mel leegi, walla sànni ko.
rule-email-legacy-mail: Ñi koy jot ak turu bataaxal bi
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ay leeral ci karta bi ci sumb bu yàgg
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Waajalaat bataaxal bii ci karta bi ni mu mel leegi? Ëmbiit bi mën na wuute ak li ñu waajaloon njëkk.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Sànni bataaxal bii? Deesu ko yónnee mukk.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Amul bataaxalu règl buy xaar ñu seetlu ko.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Mënuñu indi bataaxali règl yi xaar ñu seetlu leen. Yeesalal xët wi ngir jéemaat.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Ki sos règl bi amatu sañ-sañu dugg ci karta bii, walla règl bi soppeeku na, moo tax mënuñu lëkkalewaat bataaxal bi. Mën nga ko sànni.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Jëf ji tax ñu waajal bataaxal bii soppeeku na, moo tax mënuñu ko lëkkalewaat. Mën nga ko sànni.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Karta bi bataaxal bii jóge amatu fi, moo tax mënuñu ko lëkkalewaat. Mën nga ko sànni.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Dencatuñu doxalu règl bi waajal bataaxal bii, moo tax mënuñu ko lëkkalewaat. Mën nga ko sànni.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Bataaxal bii yónnee nañu ko, jéem nañu koo yónnee walla sànni nañu ko ba noppi.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Bataaxal bii lëkkalewaat nañu ko ba noppi.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Mënuñu sottal jëf jii. Yeesalal xët wi te jéemaat.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Jëfi Yemale Limu yu ñu manul a defaat
stuck-sync-operation-description: Benn-benn ci jëfi Yemale Limu yii ñu denc taxaw na ci digg yoon te manatul a jeex, ndax limu bi dañu ko dindi, sosaat walla jekkalaat, walla jëfandikukat bi ko tàmbali ñàkk na sañ-sañu bind. Bi benn di xaar, limu boobu manul a Yemale. Bàyyil ko ngir limu bi man a Yemaleeti: coppite yi ñu def ba noppi dañuy des, coppite yi des yi ñu denc duñu leen bind mukk, te Yemale bi topp dafay méngaleeti limu bi ak fi mu jóge.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Limu bi dañu ko dindi, sosaat walla jekkalu Yemale bi soppiku na
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Jëfandikukat bi ko tàmbali amatul sañ-sañu bind ci limu bi mat
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Benn sumb WeKan bu jiitu denc na ko te bindul li ko tàmbali
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Kayit bi wax ki ko tàmbali amul
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Man nañu koo defaat léegi te dafay jeex ci boppam, kon manuñu koo bàyyi.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Bàyyi jëfi Yemale Limu bii ñu denc? Coppite yi mu def ba noppi dañuy des; li des duñu ko bind mukk. Limu bi man na Yemaleeti ginaaw gi.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Amul jëfi Yemale Limu yu ngi xaar saytu.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: 50 yu gën a yàgg yi rekk lañu won. Bàyyil ay yenn te yeesal ngir gis yeneen.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Mënuñu yeb jëfi Yemale Limu yi. Yeesalal ngir jéemaat.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Gisuñu ne jëf bii taxaw na, kon manuñu koo bàyyi.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Man nañu koo defaat léegi te dafay jeex ci boppam, kon bàyyiwuñu ko.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Limu bii mi ngi yemaloo léegi. Jéemaatal ci kanam tuuti.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Mënuñu sottal jëf jii. Yeesalal xët wi te jéemaat.
interrupted-import-heading: Import tablo yu taxaw balaa ñu jeex
interrupted-import-description: Benn-benn ci import tablo yii taxaw na ci digg yoon - serwëer bi tàmbaliwaat na, walla import bi antuwul - te bàyyi na tablo bu matul. Import manul a wéy, ndax fiise bi mu jóge dencuñu ko. Denc tablo bi ni mu nekk, walla bàyyi ko te dugalaat fiise bi. Bàyyi dafay dindi tablo bi import bii sos ak lépp lu ci nekk, boole ci lépp lu ñu ci yokk ginaaw gi.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Ñu ngi koy bàyyi; bàyyiwaat ko ngir jeexal
interrupted-import-scrum: Taxawaayu Scrum bi am na sa checkpoint (__state__, __next__ ci __total__ tappaate). Su nga dencee tablo bi, jeexal walla bàyyi ko ci delloo import Scrum bu tablo bi.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ yoon, __lists__ limu, __cards__ karta, __checklists__ limu yu seetlu, __comments__ xalaat, __attachments__ takkaay
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Denc tablo bu matul bii ni mu nekk? Dindiwuñu dara, te import bi duñu ko limaat fii.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Bàyyi import bii? Tablo bi mu sos ak lépp lu ci nekk dañu leen di dindi ba fàww.
interrupted-import-empty: Amul import tablo yu dog yu ngi xaar saytu.
interrupted-import-truncated: 50 yu gën a yàgg yi rekk lañu won. Denc walla bàyyi ay yenn te yeesal ngir gis yeneen.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Mënuñu yeb import tablo yu dog yi. Yeesalal ngir jéemaat.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Tablo bi am id bii du import bii ko sos, kon laalewuñu ko.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Taxawaayu Scrum bi ñu ngi koy bind walla delloo. Jéemaatal ci ay simili.
interrupted-import-failed: Mënuñu sottal jëf jii. Yeesalal xët wi te jéemaat.
saml-login-not-started: Dugg bii ak SAML tàmbaliwul ci onglet bii ci joowkat bi. Baal nga, duggaat.
history-request-pending-undo: Serwëër bi dëggagul sa delloo-gannaaw gu mujj.
history-request-pending-redo: Serwëër bi dëggagul sa defaat gu mujj.
history-request-hint: Soo jéemaat, laaj bi rekk la koy yónneeti, moo tax du man a delloo gannaaw ab soppi bu ñaareel.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Neenal, defaat walla delloo coppiteb Scrum taxaw na ci xuloo. Soppi Scrum ci tablo bii dañu leen tëj ba ñu saafara ko.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ ci __total__ coppite bind nañu leen, __pending__ binduñu leen, te __conflicted__ keneen soppi na leen ginaaw gi.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Dellu ginaaw dafay delloo kayit yépp yu soppiku ni ñu nekkoon; dañu koy may rekk su kenn soppiwul kayit yooyu ginaaw gi. Denc tablo bi ni mu nekk dafay dindi jëf bi taxaw te du soppi benn kayit. Ci ñaar yépp, dañu koy bind ci Paneelu admin, Jafe-jafe, Delloo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Denc tablo bi ni mu nekk
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Denc kayit yépp ni ñu nekk léegi, boole ci coppite yi jëf bi taxaw bind ba noppi?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Admin bu tablo man na koo dellu ginaaw walla denc tablo bi ni mu nekk.
header-login: Dugg jaarale ko ci bopp yi ci HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Far lim bi ñu denc ci paneelu admin bi
login-setting-after-restart: Dina tàmbali dox gannaaw bu ñu tàmbaliwaat WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Wërngalu serwëer bi rekk moo leen di jekkal. Ñu ngi leen won fii ngir jàng rekk.
email-to-card-description: E-mail bu ñu yónnee ci adrees bu sa tablo dina nekk karta ci tablo boobu.
email-to-card-admin-enabled: Jot e-mail yi ci karta yi
email-to-card-domain: Domen bu adrees yu tablo yi
email-to-card-webhook: URL webhook bu duggu bu jox-e-mail bi (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark walla relais MIME bu ñuul)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Denc nañu ko - bàyyi ko ne mbàq ngir denc ko
email-to-card-clear-secret: Far kumpa bu webhook bu ñu dencoon
email-to-card-imap-after-seen: Mélal ko ni bu ñu jàng
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Tablo bu e-mail yu ñuy yónnee ci grain bii di dem
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Dara - e-mail yi am token bu tablo ci titre bi rekk
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Def lii ci titre bi ngir agsi ci tablo bii ni yaw ci sa bopp:
email-to-card-list: Limu ngir karta yu bees yi
email-to-card-swimlane: Yoon ngir karta yu bees yi
email-to-card-parts: Pàcc yu e-mail bi ñuy jëfandikoo
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Bàyyi bataaxal yu jëkk yu ñu tudd
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Rëddu yónnekat bi ci kaw melokaan bi
email-to-card-your-address: Sa adrees e-mail ngir tablo bii
email-to-card-address-private: Denc ko ci kumpa: ku ko am mën na yokk karta yi ni yaw.
email-to-card-new-address: Adrees bu bees (bu yàgg bi du liggéey ba noppi)
email-to-card-member-enabled: Sama adrees yu tablo yi dañuy liggéey
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Jot e-mail defaru wul ci Paneelu admin bi.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Adminu tablo taalagul e-mail ngir tablo bii.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Fey nga sa adrees yu tablo ci Jekkali bokk bi.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain bi amagul adrees e-mail. Yeesal xët wi.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Soxla nga sañ-sañu bind ci tablo bii.
inbound-domain-invalid: Loolu du turu domen bu baax.
inbound-domain-required: Joxal domen bu adrees yu tablo yi.
inbound-account-invalid: Bwat IMAP soxla na turu serwëer bu baax.
feature-views-email-desc: Tablo bi ni bwat lettar: limu e-mail yi mooy bwat bu dugg, limu yi ñooy kaas yi, etiket yi ñooy etiket yi, te bokkkat yi dañuy bind ak tontu e-mail ci adrees bu tablo bi.
email-view-not-receiving: Tablo bii jotagul e-mail. Taal ko ci Tànneef yu yégle yi ci tablo bi → E-mail ci karta.
email-view-invalid-address: Benn ci adrees yi du adrees e-mail bu baax.
email-view-no-recipient: Yokkal benn kuy jot lu mu néew.
email-view-too-many-recipients: 20 kuy jot ci bataaxal lu ëpp.
email-view-too-many: E-mail yu bari lañu yónnee ci waxtu wi weesu. Jéemaatal ci kanam.
email-view-no-list: Tablo bi soxla na benn limu ngir e-mail bi.
feature-views-chat-desc: Tablo bi ni béréb liggéey bu waxtaan: béréb liggéey yi, tablo yi, yoon yi, limu yi ak karta yi ni garab bu kanaal yi, karta bi ci digg bi ak xalaat yi mu am ni bataaxal yu waxtaan.
chat-view-message-cards: Wone rekk karta yi am bataaxal
chat-view-pick-card: Tànnal benn karta ci kanaal yi ngir gis ko fii.
chat-view-no-messages: Amagul bataaxal. Bindal bu njëkk bi.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Karta yu ni mel ci ay mboolooy kolon yu am tur - ci jeexital, solo, jatu walla leneen - ñuy leen jëlee ci diggante kolon yi ci ñu leen di diwal.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu tablo → Sàrt yi dañuy digle sàrt yu jóge ci li nit ñi di def ak loxo saa su nekk.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu tablo → Gëstu gi dafay won li ku nekk def ci tablo bi ci bés walla ayu-bés bu mujj, ak li jot gi weesu.
feature-since-last-visit: Li dale ci sa ganale bu mujj
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu tablo → Li dale ci sa ganale bu mujj dafay won li ñeneen ñi soppi ci tablo bi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Seet gu mat dafay xam kàddu yu yomb ni "samay kaart yu jot gi weesu".
column-sets-empty: Amagul mboolooy kolon ba léegi. Saytukatu tablo mën na def benn: may ko tur, te yokk ay kolonam.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Tablo bi niki topptukatu jafe-jafe yu GitHub walla Gitea: kart yi niki jafe-jafe, etiket yi ak doxin yi, xalaat yi niki waxtaan wi, takkaay yi niki fisiye, ak jaar jaaru tablo bi ak dindi.
vcs-no-issues: Amul jafe-jafe bu dëppoo ak seet bii.
vcs-no-milestones: Amagul doxin. Etiket bu am bés bu mu jeexe mooy doxin.
vcs-no-list: Tablo bii amul lim walla yoon ngir jafe-jafe bi.
card-qr-code-desc: Saytu ko ngir ubbi kart bii ci telefon walla tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Lëkkaloob kart bii dafa gudd lool ngir kod QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Amagul wiki. Dugal mbootaayu GitHub day indi fii wiki bu dépo.
github-org-import-desc: Dépo bu nekk ci mbootaay walla jëfandikukat dafay doon tablo bu boppam, ubbeeku ci Nekkinu Tablo / Saytu sumb yi: jafe-jafe yi ak seen xalaat, etiket ak fiise yi, génne yi, liggéeyu GitHub Actions yi ni Dagaat, ak wiki bi.
github-org-import-token-hint: Soxla na ngir dépo yu sutura ak tolluwaay API bu gëna kawe. Dañu koy jëfandikoo rekk bi dugal bi di dox te duñu ko denc mukk.
github-org-import-issues: Jafe-jafe yi, ak xalaat, etiket ak fiise
github-org-import-actions: Liggéeyu GitHub Actions yi ni Dagaat
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Bindal turu mbootaay walla jëfandikukat, walla adresu GitHub bi.
github-org-import-running: Dugal benn mbootaay mi ngi dox ba noppi.
optional-apis: API yu ñu mën a tànn
optional-apis-desc: REST API yu am melokaanu API yu yeneen topptukat yi, ngir seeni appli ak seeni script mën a jëfandikoo WeKan bii ni seen backend: li ñu denc, ci WeKan lañu koy denc, ci tablo yu WeKan. Bu nekk dafay fey ba ñu koy tànn fii. Benn ci ñoom amul ay sañ-sañ yu bopp: kiliyaan dafay dugg ak token API bu WeKan te mën na gis te soppi rekk li nit ki mën a gis te soppi ci WeKan. Ñoom ñépp soxla nañu WeKan REST API taal (WITH_API=true). Adrees bi nekk ci suufu bu nekk mooy li kiliyaan di jëfandikoo ni serwëram.
optional-api-trello-desc: Appli ak script yu ñu bind ngir REST API bu Trello (misaal Trellinator) dañuy liggéey ak WeKan: tablo yi, limu yi, karta yi, etiket yi, bokkkat yi, xalaat yi ak limu yu seetlu yi. Token bu Trello token API bu WeKan la. Far karta dafay yóbbu ci àrsiw bi ci WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Kiliyaan yu REST API v2 bu Jira dañuy liggéey ak WeKan: porose mooy tablo (caabiam mooy caabiu tablo bi), jafe-jafe mooy karta (DEV-7), anam mooy limu, te jàll dafay toxal karta bi. Seet dafay nangu JQL bu yomb: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ak ORDER BY. Duggal ak token API bu WeKan ni baatu jàll. Far jafe-jafe dafay yóbbu ci àrsiw bi.
optional-api-github-desc: Kiliyaan yu REST API bu GitHub ngir jafe-jafe yi dañuy liggéey ak WeKan: dencukaay mooy tablo, jafe-jafe mooy karta, ak etiket yi, doxin yi (etiket yu am bisu jeexital), xalaat yi, ak ubbeeku walla tëju ni ci Saytu sumb yi. Token bi token API bu WeKan la.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Kiliyaan yu REST API bu Gitea ak Forgejo ngir jafe-jafe yi dañuy liggéey ak WeKan, ni API bu dëppoo ak GitHub: dencukaay mooy tablo te jafe-jafe mooy karta. Token bi token API bu WeKan la.
bots-none: Amul bot ba tey. Bot mooy kuy doxal ci sa serwëer - ndawu AI, liggéeyu CI, script - bu tablo bii di jox karta yi.
bot-not-found: Bot boobu nekkul ci tablo bii.
bot-option-not-found: Tontu boobu du benn ci yi bot bi joxe.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks boppam du mën a jot ci adrees yi nekk ci réseau bu WeKan moom ci boppam, ngir kenn du mën a jublu webhook bu tablo ci benn serwiis bu biir. Bindal fii host yi nekk ci réseau boobu yi webhooks mën a jot - benn Node-RED, benn serwëer bu waxtaan - benn ci benn rëdd, niki tur walla adrees, ak port ngir may port boobu rekk. Amul dara: kenn. Admin yu site bi rekk ñoo mën a soppi list bii.
account-webhook-desc: Benn adrees bu WeKan di xamal bu kenn duggee walla bu ñu sosee kont bu bees. Dara du yónnee ba ñu tànn xew-xew ci suuf. Mu yor xew-xew bi, turu jëfandikukat bi ak waxtu wi; tànnal yeneen gox su ki koy jot soxlawoo leen rekk.
account-webhook-on-register: Bu ñu sosee kont bu bees
account-webhook-field-ip: Adreesu IP bi dugg bi jóge
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Neenal yépp yéenekaay yu ngi xaar yu jëf yi gën a yàgg ñaata fan?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Neenal nañu %s, yónnee nañu %s, %s yu gën a yàgg ngi xaar ba tey.
vcs-synced-from: Dañu ko yemale ci %s: ubbi ko te tëj ko fa.
vcs-synced-issue: Jafe-jafe bii dañu ko yemale: ubbi ko te tëj ko ci tracker bi mu bokk.
sync-issue-details: Xalaat yi, etiket yi, njaxlaay ak fisiye yi
sync-write-back: Bind coppite yi ci GitLab: bopp, melokaan, xalaat yi, tëj ak ubbiwaat
email-bounces-description: Li WeKan di def ak e-mail yu dellusi: adrees bu ñu bind ci njuumte, bwat bu fees, tontu ndax kenn nekkul, tuuma spam. Bépp xeet am na ay jëfam, ñuy def bu dellusee loolu yoon.
email-bounces-enabled: Saytu e-mail yu dellusi ci WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Bàyyi yónnee e-mail ci adrees bi
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Adrees bi amul: njuumte bind, kontu bu ñu far, domen bu ñu xamul.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Agsagul léegi: bwat bi fees na, serwëer bi dafa xëccoo. Bu bari yoon te toppante rekk lay tekki dara.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Tontu yu jóge ci ki nekkul, ci noppalu walla ci sistemu tiket. E-mail bi agsi na.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Ki ko jot def na e-mail bi spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Ci Amazon SES, yónnee yëgle yu Bounce ak Complaint, ak sàrtu jot ngir adrees bi WeKan di yónnee, ci benn topic SNS, te bindal adrees bii ci moom ci HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN yu topic SNS yu ñuy nangu, benn ci rëdd bu nekk
email-bounces-stopped-only: Adrees yi WeKan yónneetul e-mail rekk
email-bounces-clear-hint: Fàtte delluwaat yu adrees bii te yónneewaat ko e-mail
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Loolu du ARN bu topic SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Su WeKan di yónnee jaare ci benn ci sarwiis yii, taal ko, jox sarwiis bi adrees webhook bii ngir xew-xewam yu e-mail yu dellusi ak tuuma spam, te taf fii caabi gi muy xaatime leen, walla baatu jall bi nga def ci adrees bi ni https://user:password@… walla ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Sarwiis bu ñu taal soxla na caabiy xaatimam walla baatu jallam.
activity-pub-enabled: Tablo yu ñépp di gis dañuy siiwal li ñu def ci seeni karta ci fediverse bi (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Fey na ci jamono ju njëkk. Su ñu ko taalee, ku nekk ci Mastodon ak yeneen serwëër yu fediverse mën nga topp benn-benn tablo yu ñépp di gis ni @board-<id> ci adrees bu WeKan bii, te li bees ci karta yi dina àgg ci ñi ko topp. Dafa nekk ngir jàng rekk: dara lu serwëër bu fediverse yónne du soppi tablo, te tablo yu kenn rekk dees du leen mukk siiwal.
caldav-sync-desc: Def ci kalandriye bisi jeexital yu karta yi ci tablo bii - Nextcloud Calendar walla kalandriye CalDAV bu mu mën di doon. Bisu jeexital bu ñu toxal ci kalandriye bi dina dellu ci karta bi. Jëfandikoo baatu jall bu aplikaasioŋ, du sa bos.
caldav-enabled: Yamale bisi jeexital yi ak kalandriye bii
caldav-invalid-url: Adreesu kalandriye bi war na doon adrees bu http:// walla https://, te amul ci biir turu jëfandikukat walla baatu jall.
caldav-not-linked: Denc ba pare benn adreesu kalandriye te taal yamale bi.
webdav-storage-description: Denc takkaay yi ci benn dosi ci serwëër bu WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud walla bu mu mën di doon. Jëfandikoo baatu jallu aplikaasioŋ bu ñu defal WeKan. Serwëër bu nekk ci reso bu WeKan ci boppam mën nañu ko jëfandikoo fii, ndax saytukatu sit bi rekk mooy taxawal adrees bii.
sqrl-desc: Dafa fey ci njëlbéen. Bu ñu ko taalee, xëtu duggukaay bi dina joxe SQRL, te bokkkat yi dinañu jëkk yokk seen xammeekaay SQRL ci Jekkal yi ci bokkkat bi. SQRL soxla na WeKan nekk ci ab dalu https://.
sqrl-scan: Natal kood bi ak sa app SQRL, walla ubbil sa kiliyaan SQRL ci jumtukaay bii.
sqrl-expired: Kood SQRL bii jeex na. Tàmbaliwaatal.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL soxla na WeKan nekk ci ab dalu https://.
sqrl-description: Duggal ak sa xammeekaay SQRL ci barabu baatu jall. Yokk ko fii benn yoon ak sa kiliyaan SQRL; mën nga ko fi dindi saa su la neexee.
sqrl-none: Amul benn xammeekaay SQRL bu ñu yokk.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Dugg ak SQRL dañu ko fey ci kont bii jaare ko ci sa kiliyaan SQRL. Taalaatal ko foofa ak sa koodu musalkaay.
sqrl-only-on: Sa kiliyaan SQRL tëj na kont bii ci SQRL rekk: yeneen anam yépp yu ñu man a dugge dañu leen gàntu.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Sa kiliyaan SQRL tëj na kont bii bu dëgër: soppi baatu jall ak soppi e-mail dañu leen gàntu.
sqrl-only: Kont bii dañu ciy dugg ak SQRL rekk.
sqrl-hardlock: Kont bii dañu ko tëj ci SQRL: manuñu ko delloo walla soppi ci beneen anam.
windows-sso-failed: Duggu ak Windows antuwul. Xéyna sa kont Windows dañu ko mayul fii.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: Gisuñu benn blok bu ci dëppoo
